question: Kolik dolarů stála první panenka Barbie při uvedení na trh v roce 1959?
fact: První Barbie v černobílých pruhovaných plavkách stála v roce 1959 přesně 3 dolary. Zachovalý kus v původní krabici se v roce 2004 prodal na eBay za 3 552 dolarů.
sourceQuote: the original Barbie was sold for $3.00 in 1959

en.question: How many dollars did the first Barbie doll cost when it launched in 1959?
en.fact: The first Barbie, in a black-and-white striped swimsuit, cost exactly $3 in 1959. A mint one in its original box sold on eBay in 2004 for $3,552.

question: Kolik dolarů dostala studentka Carolyn Davidsonová v roce 1971 za návrh loga Nike – slavné „fajfky“ Swoosh?
fact: Za jedno z nejznámějších log světa zaplatila Nike v roce 1971 pouhých 35 dolarů – Carolyn Davidsonová si účtovala 2 dolary za hodinu a strávila nad ním 17,5 hodiny. Firma jí to později vynahradila akciemi.
sourceQuote: For her services, the company paid her $35 (equivalent to $278 in 2025) citing that she worked 17.5 hours on creating the Swoosh

en.question: How many dollars was student Carolyn Davidson paid in 1971 for designing the Nike logo, the famous Swoosh?
en.fact: Nike paid just $35 in 1971 for one of the world's best-known logos – Carolyn Davidson charged $2 an hour and spent 17.5 hours on it. The company later made it up to her with shares.

question: Kolik tisíc dolarů stála v roce 2024 jedna vstupenka na Met Gala, nejslavnější módní večer roku v New Yorku?
fact: Vstupenka na Met Gala 2024 vyšla na 75 000 dolarů, tedy zhruba 1,7 milionu korun. A to ještě nesmíte přijít v čemkoli – dress code určuje Anna Wintour.
sourceQuote: The cost of a seat per guest to attend the Met Gala rose to US$50,000 by 2023, and to $75,000 in 2024.
answerNote: Cena za jedno místo v roce 2024.

en.question: How many thousand dollars did a single ticket to the Met Gala, New York's most famous fashion night, cost in 2024?
en.fact: A ticket to the 2024 Met Gala cost $75,000. And you can't turn up in just anything – Anna Wintour sets the dress code.

question: Kolik stran mělo zářijové číslo americké Vogue z roku 2007, o jehož vzniku vypráví dokument The September Issue?
fact: Zářijová Vogue 2007 měla 840 stran a vážila skoro dvě a půl kila. Ani to nebyl rekord – zářijové číslo z roku 2012 mělo ještě o 76 stran víc.
sourceQuote: Although the 840-page issue is massive, it is not the biggest Vogue issue ever, as the September 2012 issue beats it by 76 pages (916).

en.question: How many pages did the September 2007 issue of American Vogue, the making of which is chronicled in the documentary The September Issue, have?
en.fact: The September 2007 Vogue had 840 pages and weighed almost five pounds. Even that wasn't the record – the September 2012 issue had 76 pages more.

question: Kolik způsobů uvázání kravaty napočítali fyzici Thomas Fink a Yong Mao v knize The 85 Ways to Tie a Tie (1999)?
fact: Dva fyzici z Cambridge matematicky dokázali, že klasickým způsobem (širší konec kolem užšího) jde kravatu uvázat přesně 85 způsoby. Většina lidí zvládá jeden.
sourceTitle: Wikipedia (EN): The 85 Ways to Tie a Tie
sourceQuote: there are exactly 85 ways of tying a necktie using the conventional method of wrapping the wide end of the tie around the narrow end
answerNote: Při konvenčním způsobu vázání, jak jej definuje kniha.

en.question: How many ways of tying a necktie did physicists Thomas Fink and Yong Mao count in their book The 85 Ways to Tie a Tie (1999)?
en.fact: Two Cambridge physicists proved mathematically that, using the conventional method (wide end around the narrow end), a tie can be knotted in exactly 85 ways. Most people manage one.
en.answerNote: Using the conventional tying method as defined in the book.

question: Kolik tisíc dolarů zaplatil v roce 2016 kupec za šaty, v nichž Marilyn Monroe zazpívala prezidentu Kennedymu „Happy Birthday, Mr. President“?
fact: Průsvitné šaty s 2 500 našitými kamínky se v roce 2016 vydražily za 4,8 milionu dolarů. V roce 2022 si je na Met Gala půjčila Kim Kardashian.
sourceQuote: Canadian billionaire Jim Pattison subsequently purchased the dress on November 17, 2016, at a Los Angeles auction for $4.8 million

en.question: How many thousand dollars did a buyer pay in 2016 for the dress Marilyn Monroe wore to sing 'Happy Birthday, Mr. President' to JFK?
en.fact: The sheer dress with 2,500 rhinestones sewn on sold at auction in 2016 for $4.8 million. In 2022 Kim Kardashian borrowed it for the Met Gala.

question: Kolik tisíc dolarů stály v aukci v roce 2023 tenisky Air Jordan 13, které měl Michael Jordan ve finále NBA 1998 – nejdražší tenisky v historii?
fact: Tenisky ze sezony „The Last Dance“ se v dubnu 2023 prodaly za 2,2 milionu dolarů, což je světový rekord za pár tenisek.
sourceQuote: In April 2023, Michael Jordan's Air Jordan 13s from the 1997–98 Chicago Bulls season sold for $2.2 million, setting a world record for the most valuable sneakers ever sold.

en.question: How many thousand dollars did the Air Jordan 13s worn by Michael Jordan in the 1998 NBA Finals – the most expensive sneakers ever – sell for at auction in 2023?
en.fact: The sneakers from the 'Last Dance' season sold in April 2023 for $2.2 million, a world record for a pair of sneakers.

question: Za kolik dolarů se v roce 2022 vydražily džíny Levi's z 80. let 19. století, nalezené v opuštěném dole?
fact: Zhruba 140 let staré džíny z opuštěného dolu se v Novém Mexiku prodaly za 87 400 dolarů. Nýtované džíny si Levi Strauss a Jacob Davis nechali patentovat 20. května 1873.
sourceQuote: was sold for $87,400 at an auction in New Mexico

en.question: How many dollars did a pair of 1880s Levi's jeans found in an abandoned mine sell for at auction in 2022?
en.fact: The roughly 140-year-old jeans from an abandoned mine sold in New Mexico for $87,400. Levi Strauss and Jacob Davis patented riveted jeans on 20 May 1873.

question: Kolik milionů párů bot Crocs se celosvětově prodalo od založení firmy do roku 2017?
fact: Milované i nenáviděné gumové pantofle Crocs se do roku 2017 prodaly v 300 milionech párů – to je jeden pár na každých 25 lidí na planetě.
sourceQuote: Crocs had sold 300 million pairs of shoes by year 2017.
answerNote: Kumulativní prodeje od roku 2002 do roku 2017.

en.question: How many million pairs of Crocs had been sold worldwide from the company's founding up to 2017?
en.fact: Loved and loathed in equal measure, Crocs sold 300 million pairs by 2017 – one pair for every 25 people on the planet.

question: Až kolik centimetrů měřily podrážky benátských chopin – platformových bot, které nosily dámy v 15. století?
fact: Benátské chopiny dosahovaly kolem roku 1430 výšky až 38 centimetrů. Dámy na nich potřebovaly doprovod, aby vůbec dokázaly chodit; zákon později výšku omezil na tři palce, ale nikdo ho nedodržoval.
sourceQuote: reaching heights up to 15 inches (38 cm) by 1430

en.question: Up to how many centimetres tall were the soles of Venetian chopines, the platform shoes worn by ladies in the 15th century?
en.fact: Around 1430 Venetian chopines reached heights of up to 38 centimetres. Ladies needed attendants just to walk; a law later capped them at three inches, but nobody obeyed it.

question: Za kolik milionů dolarů (bez aukční přirážky) se v prosinci 2024 vydražily rubínové střevíčky Dorotky z Čaroděje ze země Oz?
fact: Střevíčky, které v roce 2005 ukradli z muzea a FBI je našla až po 13 letech, se v roce 2024 vydražily za 28 milionů dolarů (32,5 milionu s přirážkou) – nejdražší filmová rekvizita v historii.
sourceQuote: On December 7, 2024, this pair was sold at auction for $28 million by Heritage Auctions (ultimately $32.5 million after auction house's fees are included)
answerNote: Kladívková cena; s přirážkou 32,5 milionu USD.

en.question: How many million dollars (hammer price, before fees) did Dorothy's ruby slippers from The Wizard of Oz sell for in December 2024?
en.fact: The slippers, stolen from a museum in 2005 and recovered by the FBI 13 years later, sold in 2024 for $28 million ($32.5 million with fees) – the most expensive piece of movie memorabilia ever.
en.answerNote: Hammer price; $32.5 million including buyer's premium.

question: V kolika letech byla na letišti JFK objevena modelka Kate Moss?
fact: Kate Moss objevila v roce 1988 na newyorském letišti zakladatelka agentury Storm – bylo jí 14 let a vracela se z dovolené na Bahamách.
sourceQuote: Moss was recruited as a model in 1988 at age 14 by Sarah Doukas, founder of Storm Management, at JFK Airport in New York, after a holiday in The Bahamas.

en.question: How old was Kate Moss when she was discovered at JFK airport?
en.fact: Kate Moss was spotted at New York's JFK airport in 1988 by the founder of Storm Model Management – she was 14 and on her way home from a holiday in the Bahamas.
